Clean flat textbook illustration of simple distillation and fractional distillation setups side-by-side. Left side: Simple distillation showing a round-bottom flask on a Bunsen burner, a thermometer at the top, a Liebig condenser angled downwards, and a receiving flask. Right side: Fractional distillation showing the same setup but with a tall fractionating column packed with glass beads inserted between the boiling flask and the condenser. White background.

Clean flat textbook illustration of paper chromatography. A rectangular strip of filter paper hangs inside a glass beaker with a lid. The bottom tip of the paper touches a shallow layer of solvent at the bottom. An original pencil baseline is drawn above the solvent level. Above the baseline, three colored spots (red, blue, yellow) have traveled different distances up the paper. White background.

Clean flat textbook illustration showing the separation of an insoluble solid from a liquid by filtration. A mixture is being poured from a beaker down a glass rod into a filter funnel lined with V-shaped folded filter paper. The funnel rests on a conical flask. The filter paper traps the solid, and clear liquid drips into the flask below. White background.
